papers.title: Artificial Intelligence–Powered Radiotherapy for Resource-Limited Settings: Advancing Cervical and Prostate Cancer Treatment Planning With the Radiation Planning Assistant
papers.rationale: Publisher methods and Table 1 verified 2026-11-08: retrospective internal testing, including 40 prostate end-to-end cases drawn from the 105-case held-out subset of the 1,069-patient MD Anderson cohort, plus ten cervical end-to-end cases. A separate test subset is not an external institution. No external or multicenter patient-data validation is established by the retrieved methods; E1/L2 reflects internal validation and clinical acceptability. Developer co-authors.

papers.title: Clinical Acceptability of Automated Radiation Treatment Planning for Head and Neck Cancer Using the Radiation Planning Assistant
papers.rationale: Retrospective evaluation of 50 head-and-neck cases; reviewers from multiple institutions do not make the patient cohort multinational. Clinical acceptability supports L2; developer co-authors.

papers.title: Feasibility and Clinical Acceptability of Automation-Assisted 3D Conformal Radiotherapy Planning for Patients With Cervical Cancer in a Resource-Constrained Setting
papers.rationale: External retrospective evaluation at Ocean Road Cancer Institute, Tanzania: 30 cervical cases, 29 processed. Directly measured contour/plan editing time supports L3; external patient data support E2. Developer co-authors; not a multi-national patient cohort.

papers.title: Evaluating automatically generated normal tissue contours for safe use in head and neck and cervical cancer treatment planning
papers.rationale: Retrospective evaluation of dosimetric consequences of automatically generated contours in 54 head-and-neck and 39 cervical cases; developer co-authors.

papers.title: Clinical acceptability of fully automated external beam radiotherapy for cervical cancer with three different beam delivery techniques
papers.rationale: 35 cervical CT cases from three South African centers; external evaluation of four-field box, 3D-conformal and VMAT planning, with clinical acceptability and dosimetric endpoints. Developer co-authors.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Radiotherapy Contouring and Planning to Improve Global Access to Cancer Care
papers.rationale: 75 cases reviewed by 31 clinicians from 16 institutions in six countries; more than 90% acceptable with at most minor edits. Reviewer geography must not be interpreted as the geography of the patient cohort.

papers.title: An automated treatment planning portfolio for whole breast radiotherapy
papers.rationale: Breast planning evaluation with 40 external cases from Switzerland, Argentina, Iran and the USA plus 15 internal cases. E2/L2; developer co-authors. Published online in 2024, journal issue 2025.

papers.title: Clinical implementation of deep learning robust IMPT planning in oropharyngeal cancer patients: A blinded clinical study
papers.rationale: Crossref metadata and publisher full text verified 2026-11-08. RaySearch-trained model in RayStation 11B; 60 training, 10 configuration, 10 retrospective test and 15 prospective patients. The selected plan was delivered in the prospective phase. Results apply to this configured model and do not validate all marketed models.

papers.title: Clinical implementation of deep learning-based automated left breast simultaneous integrated boost radiotherapy treatment planning
papers.rationale: Crossref metadata and full publisher text verified 2026-11-08 via Lausanne University repository. RayStation v12A model developed with RaySearch: 80 training plans, five tuning patients, ten validation patients and 17 subsequent clinical plans. Section 2.5 compares clinical and validation dose distributions, without a prospective plan-selection endpoint. E1/L2 retained; model-specific clinical use does not establish E3/L4 or patient-outcome benefit.

papers.title: Applying a pretrained DL-based IMPT planning workflow in an external center: A feasibility study in oropharyngeal cancer
papers.rationale: External-center feasibility evaluation of a pretrained RayStation DL IMPT workflow; abstract-assessed. External validation supports E2, while dosimetry and modeled NTCP support L2. Measured editing time or clinical workflow improvement is not established by the abstract. Full-methods and independence checks remain pending.

papers.rationale: Full text checked 2026-09-25 (Europe PMC). Methods name RSL-Prostate-3625-SBRT v3.0.0 deep learning planning model in RayStation 11B; retrospective single-network monitoring; no competing interests declared.

papers.title: Enhancing automated right-sided early-stage breast cancer treatments via deep learning model adaptation without additional training
papers.rationale: Full text checked 2026-09-25 (Europe PMC). RayStation 12A deep learning auto-planning adapted for right-sided breast; adapted model then used for clinical plans in 10 further patients. Developed in collaboration with RaySearch, so not vendor-independent.

papers.title: Evaluation and tuning of a commercial automated planning system for prostate radiotherapy
papers.rationale: Single-center evaluation and tuning of a commercial RayStation model. The abstract reports 335 previously planned cases across study stages; do not conflate this with a single 318-case cohort. Retrospective dosimetric assessment supports E1/L2.

safety_findings.description: Dose may be clipped during deformation near the original grid boundary, leading to underestimated accumulated dose. FSN issued October 1; Medsafe correction commenced October 6. This concerns platform dose deformation, not evidence of a defective DL predictor. No patient mistreatment was known to the manufacturer at notice issuance.
affectedVersions: RayStation 4.7 through v2026, including some service packs
safety_findings.action: Check the installed build against the notice. Review deformed dose before accumulation/evaluation, provide adequate grid margins and inform planning staff. The notice schedules a corrected release for December 2026, subject to market clearance; correction availability and local implementation are not verified.
safety_findings.authority: RaySearch manufacturer notice published by Danish Medicines Agency; Medsafe listing
